lru.label: LRU
lru.note: Native inactive-queue head: the least recently released eligible block.

fifo.label: FIFO
fifo.note: Allocation-order FIFO: evict the oldest physical copy, rather than the oldest cache publication.

mru.label: MRU
mru.note: Evict the newest eligible copy in the native inactive release queue; the opposite end from LRU.

lfu.label: LFU
lfu.note: Least physical-copy accesses, then native LRU. Initial computed use counts once; each committed cached-prefix activation adds one, including overlapping readers. Canceled reservations do not count. Counts reset on reallocation.

slru.label: SLRU
slru.note: SGLang-style segmented LRU: copies with at least two actual accesses are protected behind the probationary tier; native LRU within each tier. This is the two-tier hit-threshold variant, not a bounded protected queue.

random-0.label: Random 0
random-0.note: Uniform random replacement over native eligible candidates, ordered by LRU rank. Fixed seed 0; fresh PRNG per replay. All three seeds are reported separately without selecting a best seed.

random-1.label: Random 1
random-1.note: Uniform random replacement over native eligible candidates, ordered by LRU rank. Fixed seed 1; fresh PRNG per replay. All three seeds are reported separately without selecting a best seed.

random-2.label: Random 2
random-2.note: Uniform random replacement over native eligible candidates, ordered by LRU rank. Fixed seed 2; fresh PRNG per replay. All three seeds are reported separately without selecting a best seed.

lru-repeat.label: lru-repeat
lru-repeat.note: Native LRU replayed again; outputs must be identical.

lru-callback.label: lru-callback
lru-callback.note: LRU as a Python callback in the policy container; serving outputs must equal native LRU.

lru-no-telemetry.label: lru-no-telemetry
lru-no-telemetry.note: Native LRU without telemetry; serving outputs must equal the instrumented run.

limitation: Uncalibrated native polynomial timing on one simulated worker; not measured GPU latency.
